summary: Six distinct Tampa multifamily refinance opportunities qualify within the 2026-09-01 to 2027-08-31 window, each with active confirmed debt and executed, unextended maturities. Owners and Director of Finance contacts are verified since 2026-03-01. A prospects CSV with citations was created (artifacts/prospects-v3.csv). Remaining records were excluded for post-cutoff publication, released/unknown loans, unconfirmed/inferred maturities, executed extensions, stale ownership verification, non-owner manager relation, non-qualifying contact roles, off-scope asset type or market, or maturities outside the window.
limitations: Outstanding balances are not provided in sources and are reported as null.
Email is only included when published; some contacts (e.g., R2818) have null emails.
Cutoff rules exclude records published after 2026-08-31 (e.g., R8788) and disregard later updates such as recorded releases after the cutoff.
Duplicate base records exist (e.g., R3529 and R5565); selection is deduplicated to one sponsor slot.
